en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Having a Superior (Sauttaraduka)

Conditioned by a non-demonstrable, non-reactive, surpassable state (*dhamma*), there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and not surpassable, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

In dependence on a non-demonstrable, non-reactive, unsurpassable state, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and not unsurpassable, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.
